annotations.title: Renew a prepaid server (charges the card)

description: One more month for a monthly/annual server, charged to the saved card within the caps. Two steps: without confirmationToken returns the price and a token; with it, pays and extends the paid-until date (a server stopped at period end is restarted). [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: servers:renew) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous (quote) call, valid 10 minutes, single use.
